tasks.label: MCU: build
tasks.detail: west build + auto-sign for MCUboot + refresh compile_commands.json

tasks.label: MCU: flash (SWD)
tasks.detail: Signed image to slot0. Sets BOOT0/link GPIOs first.

tasks.label: MCU: update over serial (FOTA)
tasks.command: ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python -c "from unoq import fota; p='${env:HOME}/zephyrproject/build/zephyr/zephyr.signed.bin'; fota.upload(p); fota.test(); fota.reset(); print('swapped - run the confirm task once it boots, or it reverts')"
tasks.detail: Upload + stage + reset. No SWD. Reverts unless confirmed.

tasks.label: MCU: confirm firmware
tasks.detail: Keep the running image. Without this the next reset rolls back.

tasks.label: MCU: flash bootloader + app (recovery)
tasks.detail: Rebuilds the whole MCUboot chain over SWD.

tasks.label: MCU: console
tasks.detail: Interactive Zephyr shell. Ctrl-T then q to exit.

tasks.label: MCU: status
tasks.command: ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python -c "from unoq import MCU, link_state; print('link:', link_state()); print('mcu :', MCU().status())"
tasks.detail: Quick health check of the link and the firmware.

tasks.label: MCU: link up (BOOT0 + UART enable)
tasks.detail: Run if the board looks dead or /dev/ttyHS1 is silent.

tasks.label: Test: host (native_sim)
tasks.detail: Runs natively on the MPU. No hardware, no flash cycle.

tasks.label: Maint: check dependency versions
tasks.detail: Extension auto-update is off; this reports drift.
